SYNTHETIC ERCP REPORT
Date of service: 03/14/2031
Endoscopist: Corvin Ashdale, MD (fictional)

Findings: The duodenoscope was advanced to the major papilla.
At her index ERCP, a 10 Fr plastic biliary stent was placed in the common bile duct.
Deep biliary cannulation was achieved with a sphincterotome.
A biliary sphincterotomy was performed.
The bile duct was swept with an extraction balloon and two stones were removed.
